tasks.short: Evaluate machining procedures and recommend improvements

steps.what: Locate procedure versions and existing machining evidence for evaluation
Evaluate machining procedures and recommend changes for efficiency or adaptability

tasks.design: Configure direct links between procedure versions in {DOCS} and existing records in {OPS_SYSTEM}. The machinist checks comparability, evaluates changes in the workshop context and recommends a trial; no machine parameter is changed automatically.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the correct procedure and matching evidence can interrupt practical evaluation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native record filters and version links can reduce retrieval.
tasks.still_hard: Separating genuine process effects from material, tooling and setup differences.
tasks.human_edge: The machinist can identify why an apparent efficiency improvement would damage quality or flexibility.
tasks.altitude: Slightly less evidence hunting with improvement judgement intact.

reach.task: Agree a controlled trial of a proposed machining change

evidence.claim: Native version and record links may shorten evidence retrieval; they do not establish causal improvement or a measured saving.

assumptions: Boundary is machinist evaluation and recommendation, excluding trial execution, authorisation and production reporting.

Machinist selects procedure, revision, machine, job and date range and checks context in s1's retained 7 hours. Existing operator records are captured through unchanged production work and earn no new saving here.
No structured root-cause code, complete sensor feed or comparable cycle is assumed. Missing records require manual retrieval; noncomparable evidence is not averaged into a recommendation.
Try native links first; current filtering earns no new gain. Physical observation and recommendation retain all time.
unknowns: Existing evaluation evidence and retrieval burden
Procedure version linkage and trial authority
research_questions: Can linked versions reduce retrieval without creating misleading comparisons between unlike jobs?

already_counted.description: Evidence selection, capture and comparability checks

incremental.description: Maintain procedure links and context fields

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1: B=100, R=7+90=97; gross 3 minus 1 upkeep gives net 2. High requires repeated evidence searches; low removes only 1 hour, offset by upkeep. Evaluation and recommendation time remain intact.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Diagnose machine-tool malfunctions and adjustment needs

steps.what: Inspect machine tool symptoms and obtain relevant diagnostic measurements
Diagnose malfunctions and determine the need for adjustments or repairs

tasks.design: Retain physical inspection and diagnostic reasoning using existing diagnostic instruments {OTHER}. The machinist determines whether adjustment, repair or specialist escalation is needed; a status log does not decide the cause.
tasks.previous_blocker: Machine faults can combine mechanical, electrical, setup and wear effects.
tasks.enabler_now: Production-state capture is not validated root-cause diagnosis for this machine.
tasks.still_hard: Selecting discriminating tests and recognising when further testing would be unsafe.
tasks.human_edge: The machinist connects unusual physical behaviour with setup history and can escalate uncertainty.
tasks.altitude: Diagnostic time and maintenance boundaries remain unchanged.

reach.task: Review an uncertain machine-tool malfunction with the observed evidence
reach.learn: Diagnostic escalation and safe isolation boundaries

evidence.claim: Machine-state records alone do not establish a safe replacement for physical fault isolation and professional diagnosis.

assumptions: Boundary is diagnosis and need determination, excluding repair execution and machine release.
Machinist produces observations and measurements in s1 before concluding in s2. Diagnostic instruments are {OTHER}; no structured fault or root-cause label is supplied free.
Existing instrument functions are baseline. Review native diagnostic facilities before future custom work; no runtime saving is claimed.
No software, automatic machine action or new process is introduced; upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Machine types and authorised diagnostic scope
research_questions: Which faults lack reliable distinguishing measurements rather than faster record access?

already_counted.description: Physical fault investigation and diagnostic judgement

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100 and upkeep=0. Familiar and intermittent faults retain investigation and reasoning time; no reporting baseline is added.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Design special fixtures, tooling and experimental parts

steps.what: Determine special engineering needs and develop a fixture or tooling concept
Design the fixture, tooling or experimental part drawings and dimensions
Check the design against special engineering needs and manufacturing constraints

tasks.design: Configure reusable standard component details and drawing templates in design software {OTHER}. The machinist creates the special concept and dimensions, checks the assembled proposal and sends it through the existing engineering review before manufacture.
tasks.previous_blocker: Drawing known standard details can repeat work within otherwise bespoke designs.
tasks.enabler_now: Native libraries and templates can reduce that repeated drafting.
tasks.still_hard: Clamping, access, strength, tolerance and experimental uncertainty in a novel design.
tasks.human_edge: The machinist can anticipate how a fixture will behave during loading and machining.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated standard-detail drafting; novel design and checks retain their time.

reach.task: Review a proposed fixture for practical manufacture and use
reach.learn: Design intent, tolerance and access constraints

evidence.claim: Native standard-component libraries may reduce repeated drawing work in bespoke tooling; this does not automate engineering design or prove safety.

assumptions: Boundary is concept and design proposal, excluding engineering approval, manufacture and physical proving.

Machinist produces geometry, load assumptions, datums, clearances, material and constraints in s1 with all 60 hours retained. s2 retains 20 hours for parameter capture, standard-detail selection, drawing and manual exceptions.
No structured fully constrained design is assumed. If a component is not suitable or its data are incomplete, draw it manually; no unsafe inference or automatic manufacture follows.
Test native libraries before custom generators. Existing reuse earns no new gain. s3 preserves all design checking and grants no additional engineering approval rights.
unknowns: Proportion of reusable detail and design software
research_questions: Can standard-detail reuse shorten drawing work without carrying incorrect dimensions or load assumptions into a bespoke fixture?

already_counted.description: Parameter capture, drawing and standard-detail checking

incremental.description: Maintain approved standard details and versions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1: B=100, R=60+20+15=95; gross 5 minus 2 upkeep gives net 3. High requires reusable standard details; low removes only 2 hours in bespoke work, offset by upkeep. Concept and final checks keep all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Exchange technical information with engineering and production colleagues

steps.what: Confer with engineering, supervisory or manufacturing personnel to exchange technical information

tasks.design: Retain direct technical exchange and clarification. Relevant source documents can remain in {DOCS}; this task does not establish a separate minutes-writing or reporting duty to automate.
tasks.previous_blocker: Different colleagues hold practical information that must be explained and reconciled.
tasks.enabler_now: Document access supports the conversation but does not replace its meaning or relationship work.
tasks.still_hard: Explaining tacit observations and resolving differing interpretations.
tasks.human_edge: The machinist can notice misunderstanding and demonstrate the physical issue.
tasks.altitude: Technical conversation time and decision rights remain unchanged.

reach.task: Clarify a machining constraint before committing production work

evidence.claim: Technical information exchange requires shared interpretation; no distinct removable administrative step is established by this task.

assumptions: Boundary is the machinist's participation in technical exchange, excluding colleagues' labour and source-document creation.
Participants produce and clarify information during the retained conversation. No structured question or complete defect record is assumed free.
Existing source access is baseline; review native communication facilities before later custom work. No recording or staff monitoring is introduced.
No software or maintained process is introduced, so upkeep is zero. Overlap with specific programmer verification is allocated once in role totals.
unknowns: Typical technical questions and present communication routes
research_questions: Are recurring delays caused by missing source access or by necessary technical clarification?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100 and upkeep=0. Routine and complex technical exchanges retain discussion time; no minutes-writing baseline is invented.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce small amounts of evidence retrieval and repeated drawing while retaining engineering judgement, diagnosis and technical exchange.
reach: Work with supervisors and tool makers on explicit evidence, constraints and unresolved design questions
role.ambitious_version: A machinist who uses dependable source links and reusable details while keeping bespoke decisions grounded in physical workshop conditions.
